characters.prompt: Use the exact face of the man in the reference photo. Character master sheet: one single image, a clean 3x3 grid of nine photo panels separated by thin white gutters on a pure white background, no header, no captions. TOP ROW (three head-and-shoulders portraits of the SAME person): left = straight frontal view, middle = 45-degree three-quarter view, right = strict left profile. MIDDLE ROW: left = full-body frontal standing view with feet visible, middle = full-body back view, right = full-body left side view. BOTTOM ROW (three head-and-shoulders portraits): left = neutral calm, middle = faint gentle smile, right = tense worried. Subject: the same Korean man in his early 60s, round face, short neat salt-and-pepper hair, weathered skin, calm watchful eyes. Wardrobe locked in every panel: a plain dark navy security guard uniform shirt with NO name tag, NO badge and NO patch of any kind (completely plain chest), black duty belt with an old handheld radio, plain dark trousers, black work shoes, bare head with NO hat or cap in any panel, no glasses. Identical face, hair and clothing in all nine panels, photorealistic, soft even studio lighting. Photorealistic live-action, Arri Alexa cinematic color grade, Kodak 35mm film grain, 24fps, soft natural key light from upper-left, subtle warm rim light, no flat lighting. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos or watermarks anywhere. Negative: gibberish, foreign text, incomprehensible letters, fake alphabets, text on badge, text on name tag, logo on shirt, signage lettering, watermarks, stamps, symbols on collar, bad anatomy, deformed eyes, extra fingers.
